parse_mmcif_from_string: parse an mmCIF string into an Mmcif object using from_string for structural biology data
parse_multi_data_cif: parse a multi-data CIF string into a dictionary of named Mmcif objects
convert_chain_id: convert between integer and string mmCIF chain IDs using int_id_to_str_id and str_id_to_int_id
extract_bond_atom_indices: extract from and to atom indices for bonds defined in the struct_conn table of an mmCIF
parse_oper_expression: parse an mmCIF oper_expression string into a list of transform ID tuples for symmetry operations
